name: fetch-no-options
reason: No cancellation signal supplied; candidate, not automatically a bug.

name: fetch-inline-signal
reason: Inline signal present.

name: fetch-shorthand-signal
reason: Shorthand signal present.

name: fetch-options-variable
source: const c=new AbortController(); const options={signal:c.signal}; fetch("https://example.invalid",options);
reason: Known options object carries a real signal.

name: fetch-spread-options
reason: Spread preserves signal.

name: fetch-request-object
source: const c=new AbortController(); const request=new Request("https://example.invalid",{signal:c.signal}); fetch(request);
reason: Request carries its own cancellation signal.

name: fetch-inline-request
reason: Inline Request also carries signal.

name: fetch-forwarded-init
source: export function forward(url, init: RequestInit){ return fetch(url,init); }
reason: Unknown caller options cannot prove absent signal; abstain or narrower claim.

name: fetch-local-lookalike
reason: Synchronous local function, not network fetch.

name: fetch-parameter-lookalike
reason: Caller-provided unrelated function is not established network fetch.

name: fetch-signal-undefined
reason: No usable cancellation signal despite a property key.

name: fetch-signal-null
reason: Null does not supply an abort controller signal.

name: fetch-computed-signal
reason: Static computed property supplies signal.

name: fetch-comment-before-signal
source: const c=new AbortController(); fetch("https://example.invalid",{/* cancellation */ signal:c.signal});
reason: Comment does not disable the property.

name: fetch-overridden-signal
reason: Later spread overrides the signal.

name: fetch-no-call-comment
reason: Comments/strings are not calls.

name: fetch-nested-signal
reason: A nested key is not RequestInit.signal.

name: fetch-global-member
reason: Real global fetch in a member form; tests declared coverage limitation.

name: map-dropped-binding
reason: Real array of promises dropped.

name: map-bare-discard
reason: Bare real array map result dropped.

name: map-await-array
reason: Awaiting an ordinary array does not await its elements.

name: map-combined
reason: Correct iterable of promises passed to real combiner.

name: map-returned-binding
source: export function f(){ const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); return tasks; }
reason: Returning an array transfers it to caller; not proof of dropped promises.

name: map-helper-consumption
source:
async function settle(tasks){return await Promise.all(tasks)}
const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); await settle(tasks);
reason: Helper actually settles the array.

name: map-aliased-consumption
source: const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); const pending=tasks; await Promise.all(pending);
reason: Alias points to same array consumed by combiner.

name: map-for-await
source: const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); for await (const result of tasks) { console.log(result); }
reason: for-await unwraps each yielded promise.

name: map-per-element-await
source: const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); for (const task of tasks) { await task; }
reason: Each element explicitly awaited.

name: map-inline-combiner
reason: Direct inline consumption.

name: map-nested-array-combiner
reason: Combiner does not recursively settle nested arrays.

name: map-combiner-unrelated-callback
reason: Nested discarded inner map is not consumed by outer combiner.

name: map-length-in-combiner
reason: Reading array length in combiner does not settle elements.

name: map-spread-into-combiner
reason: Spread passes individual promises.

name: map-shadowed-combiner
source: const Promise={all:async x=>null}; const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); await Promise.all(tasks);
reason: Same-named object does not perform promise settlement.

name: map-await-object-containing-element
source: const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); for(const task of tasks){ await {task}; }
reason: Awaiting object containing a promise does not unwrap its field.

name: map-unrelated-scope-combiner
source: const tasks=[1,2].map(async x=>x); function other(){ const tasks=[]; return Promise.all(tasks); }
reason: Other binding cannot consume first array.

name: map-local-object-method
source: const object={async map(callback){return await callback(1)}}; await object.map(async x=>x);
reason: Custom map is promise-returning and is properly awaited.

name: map-returned-direct
reason: Direct return transfers the array.

name: map-filtered-chain-discard
reason: Dropped array behind chained receiver; tests declared coverage limitation.

name: map-const-enclosing-function
reason: Passing the enclosing function value does not consume inner map results.

name: map-async-function-callback
reason: Async function callback has same promise-array semantics.

name: timer-positive
reason: Effect starts a timer without cancellation cleanup.

name: timer-cleanup
reason: Cleanup clears same handle.

name: timer-window-cleanup
reason: Window qualification preserves timer identity and cleanup.

name: timer-globalthis-cleanup
reason: Global qualification preserves cleanup.

name: timer-local-effect-lookalike
reason: Local ordinary function is not a React effect.

name: timer-local-timer-lookalike
reason: Synchronous local function is not a timer.

name: timer-local-clear-lookalike
source:
import {useEffect} from "react";
useEffect(()=>{const clearTimeout=()=>{}; const timer=setTimeout(()=>{},100);return ()=>clearTimeout(timer);},[]);
reason: Unrelated clearTimeout does not cancel timer.

name: timer-shadowed-handle
reason: Cleanup clears different shadowed binding.

name: timer-unused-clear-helper
reason: Never invoked or returned helper is not cleanup.

name: timer-wrong-handle
reason: Second timer is uncancelled.

name: timer-concise-effect
reason: Concise effect returns undefined and creates an uncancelled timer.

name: timer-alias-effect
reason: Real React effect import alias; tests declared limitation.

name: timer-namespace-effect
reason: Real namespace React effect.

name: timer-outside-effect
reason: Outside this effect-specific rule.

name: timer-helper-cleanup
reason: Started helper timer cleared through shared handle.
